newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares largely flat as Wall St disappoints.
newsitem.headline: German shares largely flat as Wall St disappoints.

text.p: German shares were little changed in early bourse trade on Tuesday as dealers said there was wide disappointment that Wall Street's overnight close was below the highs reached earlier in the session.
The DAX-30 index of leading German shares slipped 1.11 points to 2,880.21 in early trade, while March DAX futures fell 15.0 points at 2,892.0.

Wall Street had closed 0.35 percent up, a negligible gain compared to the strong rally seen at the end of last week, while the dollar was thinly traded after an overnight fall which took it to around 1.5615 marks.
Dealers said German November industry orders, due at 1100 GMT, would be studied for indications of the strength of the German economy but were unlikely to give any major push to share values.
Earlier, there had been no significant reaction to the DIW economic institute lowering its 1997 German GDP growth to 2.0 percent from 2.5 percent before.
Drug group Schering AG rose 3.55 marks to 132.25 on what were said to be technical factors after breaching the 129 mark level.
Car-maker Volkswagen, which had made strong gains on Monday on reports of plans for a new "mini-car" and amid general optimism surrounding the auto sector, slipped back 50 pfennigs to 651.00 marks.
